              "file": "scripts/local-gate.sh",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/local-gate.sh\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/local-gate.sh\t\n+++ scripts/local-gate.sh\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,170 @@\n+#!/usr/bin/env bash\n+# Run the fail-closed local gate directly and retain revision/architecture/result evidence.\n+set -euo pipefail\n+\n+ROOT=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")/..\" && pwd)\"\n+TASK_ID=\"${TASK_ID:-M01}\"\n+PROFILE=\"${1:-m01}\"\n+if (( $# > 1 )) || [[ ! \"$PROFILE\" =~ ^(m01|m02|check|release)$ ]]; then\n+  printf 'Usage: %s [m01|m02|check|release]\\n' \"${0##*/}\" >&2\n+  exit 2\n+fi\n+if [[ ! \"$TASK_ID\" =~ ^(M0[0-8]|R-M0[0-8]-[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]; then\n+  printf 'TASK_ID must be an M00-M08 or R-M##-<n> identifier.\\n' >&2\n+  exit 2\n+fi\n+\n+STARTED_UTC=\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\"\n+RUN_STAMP=\"$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)\"\n+NATIVE_ARCH=\"$(uname -m)\"\n+REVISION=\"$(git -C \"$ROOT\" rev-parse --verify HEAD)\"\n+if [[ -n \"$(git -C \"$ROOT\" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)\" ]]; then\n+  DIRTY=\"true\"\n+else\n+  DIRTY=\"false\"\n+fi\n+RUN_DIR=\"$ROOT/test-results/local-gates/${TASK_ID}-${RUN_STAMP}\"\n+RECORD=\"$RUN_DIR/evidence.json\"\n+mkdir -p \"$RUN_DIR/python\"\n+export STOCK_PROBS_PACKAGE_ARTIFACT_DIR=\"$RUN_DIR/package\"\n+export STOCK_PROBS_REVISION=\"$REVISION\"\n+export STOCK_PROBS_DATA_DIR=\"$RUN_DIR/runtime\"\n+export STOCK_PROBS_BROWSER_ARTIFACT_DIR=\"$RUN_DIR/browser\"\n+export STOCK_PROBS_BROWSER_RUNTIME=\"$RUN_DIR/browser-runtime\"\n+export STOCK_PROBS_TASK_ID=\"$TASK_ID\"\n+PYTHON=\"$ROOT/.dev-venv/bin/python\"\n+NODE_BIN=\"$ROOT/.tools/node/bin\"\n+COMPLETED_CHECKS=()\n+\n+write_record() {\n+  local result=\"$1\"\n+  local exit_code=\"$2\"\n+  python3 - \"$RECORD\" \"$result\" \"$exit_code\" \"$TASK_ID\" \"$REVISION\" \"$DIRTY\" \\\n+    \"$NATIVE_ARCH\" \"$STARTED_UTC\" \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\" \"$RUN_DIR\" \\\n+    \"$PROFILE\" \"$(IFS=,; printf '%s' \"${COMPLETED_CHECKS[*]}\")\" <<'PY'\n+import json\n+import sys\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+(\n+    record,\n+    result,\n+    exit_code,\n+    task,\n+    revision,\n+    dirty,\n+    architecture,\n+    started,\n+    finished,\n+    run_dir,\n+    profile,\n+    completed_checks,\n+) = sys.argv[1:]\n+run_path = Path(run_dir)\n+artifacts = sorted(\n+    str(path.relative_to(run_path)) for path in run_path.rglob(\"*\") if path.is_file()\n+)\n+payload = {\n+    \"task\": task,\n+    \"revision\": revision,\n+    \"working_tree_dirty\": dirty == \"true\",\n+    \"native_architecture\": architecture,\n+    \"execution_label\": f\"native {architecture}\",\n+    \"started_utc\": started,\n+    \"finished_utc\": finished,\n+    \"command\": [\"./scripts/local-gate.sh\", profile],\n+    \"profile\": profile,\n+    \"completed_checks\": [item for item in completed_checks.split(\",\") if item],\n+    \"result\": result,\n+    \"exit_code\": int(exit_code),\n+    \"artifacts\": [\"evidence.json\", *artifacts],\n+}\n+Path(record).write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + \"\\n\")\n+PY\n+}\n+\n+on_exit() {\n+  local exit_code=\"$?\"\n+  trap - EXIT\n+  set +e\n+  if (( exit_code == 0 )); then\n+    write_record \"Pass\" \"$exit_code\"\n+  else\n+    write_record \"Fail\" \"$exit_code\"\n+  fi\n+  printf 'Local gate evidence: %s\\n' \"$RECORD\"\n+  exit \"$exit_code\"\n+}\n+trap on_exit EXIT\n+\n+run_check() {\n+  \"$PYTHON\" -m ruff check src tests scripts\n+  \"$PYTHON\" -m mypy src/stock_probs/backup.py src/stock_probs/cli.py\n+  \"$PYTHON\" -m compileall -q src tests scripts\n+  bash -n scripts/*.sh\n+  \"$PYTHON\" scripts/comment_audit.py\n+  \"$PYTHON\" -m pytest -m \"not live\" --cov=stock_probs --cov-report=term-missing \\\n+    --cov-fail-under=85 --junitxml=\"$RUN_DIR/python/junit.xml\"\n+  \"$PYTHON\" -m ruff check --select S --ignore S101 src tests scripts\n+  \"$PYTHON\" -m pytest tests/test_repository_backup.py tests/test_backup_cli.py -q\n+}\n+\n+run_package() {\n+  \"$PYTHON\" scripts/package_smoke.py\n+}\n+\n+run_browser() {\n+  \"$ROOT/scripts/install-node.sh\"\n+  PATH=\"$NODE_BIN:$PATH\" \"$NODE_BIN/npm\" --prefix \"$ROOT/tools/browser\" ci\n+  local port\n+  port=\"$($PYTHON -c \\\n+    'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()')\"\n+  PATH=\"$NODE_BIN:$PATH\" STOCK_PROBS_BROWSER_PORT=\"$port\" \\\n+    \"$NODE_BIN/npm\" --prefix \"$ROOT/tools/browser\" test\n+}\n+\n+run_mcp() {\n+  PATH=\"$NODE_BIN:$PATH\" \"$NODE_BIN/node\" \"$ROOT/tools/browser/mcp-smoke.js\"\n+}\n+\n+printf 'task=%s revision=%s dirty=%s native_arch=%s profile=%s\\n' \\\n+  \"$TASK_ID\" \"$REVISION\" \"$DIRTY\" \"$NATIVE_ARCH\" \"$PROFILE\"\n+printf 'Local scripts are authoritative only with independent review; no external pipeline is used.\\n'\n+\"$ROOT/scripts/bootstrap.sh\"\n+cd \"$ROOT\"\n+\n+case \"$PROFILE\" in\n+  check)\n+    run_check\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"python-checks\")\n+    ;;\n+  m01)\n+    run_package\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"package\")\n+    run_check\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"python-checks\")\n+    ;;\n+  m02)\n+    run_package\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"package\")\n+    run_check\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"python-checks\")\n+    run_browser\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"browser\")\n+    run_mcp\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"playwright-mcp\")\n+    ;;\n+  release)\n+    run_package\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"package\")\n+    run_check\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"python-checks\")\n+    run_browser\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"browser\")\n+    run_mcp\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"playwright-mcp\")\n+    \"$PYTHON\" -m stock_probs.cli migrate\n+    \"$PYTHON\" -m pytest tests/test_backup_cli.py -q\n+    COMPLETED_CHECKS+=(\"release-migration-backup\")\n+    ;;\n+esac\n",
              "additions": 170,
              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },
            {
              "file": "scripts/package_smoke.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/package_smoke.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/package_smoke.py\t\n+++ scripts/package_smoke.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,244 @@\n+\"\"\"Build, inspect, and run a clean non-editable wheel from outside the source tree.\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import argparse\n+import json\n+import os\n+import platform\n+import shutil\n+import socket\n+import subprocess\n+import sys\n+import tempfile\n+import time\n+import urllib.request\n+import zipfile\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n+EXPECTED_RESOURCES = {\n+    \"stock_probs/static/index.html\",\n+    \"stock_probs/static/app.css\",\n+    \"stock_probs/static/app.js\",\n+    \"stock_probs/static/api-docs.html\",\n+    \"stock_probs/static/favicon.svg\",\n+    \"stock_probs/migrations/001_initial.sql\",\n+    \"stock_probs/migrations/002_historical_analysis.sql\",\n+    \"stock_probs/migrations/003_restore_and_immutability_guards.sql\",\n+    \"stock_probs/fixtures/acdc.json\",\n+    \"stock_probs/fixtures/spy.json\",\n+}\n+\n+REGISTERED_MIGRATION_CHECK = \"\"\"\\\n+from importlib.resources import files\n+from stock_probs.repository import MIGRATION_NAME, MIGRATION_SHA256\n+\n+names = sorted(\n+    item.name for item in files(\"stock_probs.migrations\").iterdir()\n+    if item.name.endswith(\".sql\")\n+)\n+matches = [MIGRATION_NAME.fullmatch(name) for name in names]\n+invalid = [name for name, match in zip(names, matches, strict=True) if match is None]\n+if invalid:\n+    raise RuntimeError(f\"wheel contains invalid migration names: {invalid}\")\n+packaged_versions = [int(match.group(\"version\")) for match in matches if match is not None]\n+registered_versions = sorted(MIGRATION_SHA256)\n+if packaged_versions != registered_versions:\n+    raise RuntimeError(\n+        f\"wheel migration versions {packaged_versions} do not match registry {registered_versions}\"\n+    )\n+print(names)\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+\n+def _run(command: list[str], *, cwd: Path, env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> None:\n+    print(\"+\", \" \".join(command), flush=True)\n+    subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, check=True)  # noqa: S603\n+\n+\n+def _free_loopback_port() -> int:\n+    with socket.socket() as listener:\n+        listener.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\n+        return int(listener.getsockname()[1])\n+\n+\n+def _wait_for_json(url: str, expected_status: str, process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:\n+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 20\n+    last_error: Exception | None = None\n+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n+        if process.poll() is not None:\n+            raise RuntimeError(f\"wheel-installed server exited with {process.returncode}\")\n+        try:\n+            # Only a generated loopback URL is accepted; this smoke never contacts a provider.\n+            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=1) as response:  # noqa: S310\n+                payload = json.load(response)\n+            if payload.get(\"status\") == expected_status:\n+                return\n+        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:\n+            last_error = exc\n+            time.sleep(0.1)\n+    raise RuntimeError(f\"wheel-installed server was not ready: {last_error}\")\n+\n+\n+def _stop(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:\n+    if process.poll() is not None:\n+        return\n+    process.terminate()\n+    try:\n+        process.wait(timeout=10)\n+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n+        process.kill()\n+        process.wait(timeout=5)\n+\n+\n+def _copy_build_input(destination: Path) -> None:\n+    shutil.copy2(ROOT / \"pyproject.toml\", destination / \"pyproject.toml\")\n+    shutil.copytree(ROOT / \"src\", destination / \"src\")\n+\n+\n+def main() -> None:\n+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n+    parser.add_argument(\n+        \"--artifact-dir\",\n+        type=Path,\n+        default=Path(os.getenv(\"STOCK_PROBS_PACKAGE_ARTIFACT_DIR\", \"test-results/package\")),\n+    )\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--expected-machine\")\n+    args = parser.parse_args()\n+\n+    machine = platform.machine().lower()\n+    if args.expected_machine and This insert\n+-- trigger gives upgraded and clean databases the same cross-column guarantees.\n+CREATE TRIGGER validate_search_event_analysis_insert BEFORE INSERT ON search_events\n+WHEN\n+    NEW.analysis_kind NOT IN ('submitted_forecast', 'fresh_historical_reconstruction')\n+    OR (\n+        NEW.analysis_kind = 'submitted_forecast'\n+        AND (NEW.source_event_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.requested_cutoff IS NOT NULL)\n+    )\n+    OR (\n+        NEW.analysis_kind = 'fresh_historical_reconstruction'\n+        AND NEW.status != 'failed'\n+        AND NEW.requested_cutoff IS NULL\n+    )\n+    OR (\n+        NEW.analysis_kind = 'fresh_historical_reconstruction'\n+        AND NEW.status != 'failed'\n+        AND (\n+            NEW.source_event_id IS NULL\n+            OR NOT EXISTS (\n+                SELECT 1 FROM search_events AS source\n+                WHERE source.id = NEW.source_event_id AND source.run_id IS NOT NULL\n+            )\n+        )\n+    )\n+BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid search event analysis provenance');\n+END;\n+\n+-- Migration receipts are operational evidence and must not be rewritten to make a\n+-- changed or partially applied schema appear current. Future upgrades only append.\n+CREATE TRIGGER immutable_schema_migrations_update BEFORE UPDATE ON schema_migrations BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'schema_migrations are append-only');\n+END;\n+CREATE TRIGGER immutable_schema_migrations_delete BEFORE DELETE ON schema_migrations BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'schema_migrations are append-only');\n+END;\n",
              "additions": 51,
              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },
            {
              "file": "src/stock_probs/migrations/003_restore_and_immutability_guards.sql",
              "patch": "Index: src/stock_probs/migrations/003_restore_and_immutability_guards.sql\n===================================================================\n--- src/stock_probs/migrations/003_restore_and_immutability_guards.sql\t\n+++ src/stock_probs/migrations/003_restore_and_immutability_guards.sql\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@\n+-- M02 closes REPLACE and reconstruction-provenance gaps without rewriting prior migrations.\n+ALTER TABLE search_events\n+    ADD COLUMN requested_source_event_id INTEGER;\n+\n+-- A requested source is audit context; source_event_id is an FK only when that source is a\n+-- real successful event. Failed unknown-source attempts therefore remain appendable and honest.\n+CREATE TRIGGER validate_search_event_analysis_contract_insert BEFORE INSERT ON search_events\n+WHEN\n+    (\n+        NEW.analysis_kind = 'submitted_forecast'\n+        AND (\n+            NEW.source_event_id IS NOT NULL\n+            OR NEW.requested_source_event_id IS NOT NULL\n+            OR NEW.requested_cutoff IS NOT NULL\n+        )\n+    )\n+    OR (\n+        NEW.analysis_kind = 'fresh_historical_reconstruction'\n+        AND (\n+            typeof(NEW.requested_source_event_id) != 'integer'\n+            OR NEW.requested_source_event_id < 1\n+            OR NEW.requested_cutoff IS NULL\n+            OR length(NEW.requested_cutoff) = 0\n+            OR (\n+                EXISTS (\n+                    SELECT 1 FROM search_events AS requested_source\n+                    WHERE requested_source.id = NEW.requested_source_event_id\n+                      AND requested_source.run_id IS NOT NULL\n+                )\n+                AND NEW.source_event_id IS NOT NEW.requested_source_event_id\n+            )\n+            OR (\n+                NOT EXISTS (\n+                    SELECT 1 FROM search_events AS requested_source\n+                    WHERE requested_source.id = NEW.requested_source_event_id\n+                      AND requested_source.run_id IS NOT NULL\n+                )\n+                AND NEW.source_event_id IS NOT NULL\n+            )\n+            OR (\n+                NEW.status != 'failed'\n+                AND NEW.source_event_id IS NULL\n+            )\n+        )\n+    )\n+BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid search event analysis contract');\n+END;\n+\n+-- SQLite suppresses the DELETE half of REPLACE when recursive_triggers is OFF. Rejecting every\n+-- existing primary or natural key in BEFORE INSERT makes immutability connection-independent.\n+CREATE TRIGGER immutable_forecast_runs_insert_conflict BEFORE INSERT ON forecast_runs\n+WHEN\n+    (NEW.id > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forecast_runs WHERE id = NEW.id))\n+    OR EXISTS (\n+        SELECT 1 FROM forecast_runs\n+        WHERE symbol = NEW.symbol\n+          AND asset_type = NEW.asset_type\n+          AND content_fingerprint = NEW.content_fingerprint\n+    )\n+BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'forecast_runs are immutable');\n+END;\n+\n+CREATE TRIGGER immutable_search_events_insert_conflict BEFORE INSERT ON search_events\n+WHEN\n+    (NEW.id > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_events WHERE id = NEW.id))\n+    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_events WHERE request_id = NEW.request_id)\n+BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'search_events are append-only');\n+END;\n+\n+CREATE TRIGGER immutable_forecast_inputs_insert_conflict BEFORE INSERT ON forecast_inputs\n+WHEN\n+    (NEW.id > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forecast_inputs WHERE id = NEW.id))\n+    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forecast_inputs WHERE run_id = NEW.run_id)\n+BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'forecast_inputs are immutable');\n+END;\n+\n+CREATE TRIGGER immutable_forecast_results_insert_conflict BEFORE INSERT ON forecast_results\n+WHEN\n+    (NEW.id > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forecast_results WHERE id = NEW.id))\n+    OR EXISTS (\n+        SELECT 1 FROM forecast_results\n+        WHERE input_id = NEW.input_id AND horizon = NEW.horizon\n+    )\n+BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'forecast_results are immutable');\n+END;\n+\n+CREATE TRIGGER append_only_outcomes_insert_conflict BEFORE INSERT ON outcomes\n+WHEN NEW.id > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outcomes WHERE id = NEW.id)\n+BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'outcomes are append-only');\n+END;\n+\n+CREATE TRIGGER immutable_schema_migrations_insert_conflict BEFORE INSERT ON schema_migrations\n+WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = NEW.version)\n+BEGIN\n+    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'schema_migrations are append-only');\n+END;\n",
              "additions": 102,
              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },

Symbol syntax is audited by the domain so validly submitted bad symbols persist as failures.\n     symbol: str = Field(max_length=64)\n     asset_type: Literal[\"stock\", \"etf\"]\n \n \n+class InstrumentIdentityResponse(StrictModel):\n+    \"\"\"Facts that together distinguish one supported Yahoo instrument.\"\"\"\n+\n+    canonical_symbol: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=15)\n+    display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)\n+    company_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)\n+    exchange: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)\n+    currency: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=12)\n+    timezone: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)\n+    quote_type: Literal[\"EQUITY\", \"STOCK\", \"ETF\"]\n+    asset_type: Literal[\"stock\", \"etf\"]\n+    provider: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)\n+    provider_as_of: datetime\n+\n+\n+class InstrumentLookupResponse(StrictModel):\n+    \"\"\"A display name is always coupled to identity instead of returned as a loose match.\"\"\"\n+\n+    query: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)\n+    items: list[InstrumentIdentityResponse]\n+    total: int = Field(ge=0, le=5)\n+    limit: int = Field(ge=1, le=5)\n+\n+\n class OutcomeRequest(StrictModel):\n     observed_close: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0, le=10_000_000)\n     observed_at: datetime\n     state: Literal[\"observed\", \"unavailable\", \"provisional\", \"corrected\"]\n     note: str = Field(default=\"\", max_length=500)\n \n     @model_validator(mode=\"after\")\n     def close_required_for_observation(self) -> OutcomeRequest:\n         if self.state != \"unavailable\" and self.observed_close is None:\n             raise ValueError(\"observed_close is required unless state is unavailable\")\n         # Unavailable is an explicit missing observation, never a price-bearing correction.\n         if self.state == \"unavailable\" and self.observed_close is not None:\n             raise ValueError(\"observed_close must be omitted when state is unavailable\")\n         if self.observed_at.tzinfo is None:\n             raise ValueError(\"observed_at must include a timezone offset\")\n         return self\n \n \n+class CorrectionRequest(StrictModel):\n+    \"\"\"A correction is a new observation entry, never an edit instruction.\"\"\"\n+\n+    observed_close: float = Field(gt=0, le=10_000_000)\n+    observed_at: datetime\n+    note: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)\n+\n+    @model_validator(mode=\"after\")\n+    def timezone_required(self) -> CorrectionRequest:\n+        if self.observed_at.tzinfo is None:\n+            raise ValueError(\"observed_at must include a timezone offset\")\n+        return self\n+\n+\n+class FreshReconstructionRequest(StrictModel):\n+    \"\"\"Label a historical-cutoff request so it cannot be confused with saved replay.\"\"\"\n+\n+    analysis_kind: Literal[\"fresh_historical_reconstruction\"] = (\n+        \"fresh_historical_reconstruction\"\n+    )\n+    cutoff: datetime\n+\n+    @model_validator(mode=\"after\")\n+    def bounded_aware_cutoff(self) -> FreshReconstructionRequest:\n+        if self.cutoff.tzinfo is None:\n+            raise ValueError(\"cutoff must include a timezone offset\")\n+        # Pre-2000 cutoffs cannot be served by the deliberately bounded provider windows.\n+        if self.cutoff.astimezone(UTC) < datetime(2000, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC):\n+            raise ValueError(\"cutoff must be on or after 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z\")\n+        return self\n+\n+\n class BackupRequest(StrictModel):\n     name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=10, max_length=73)\n \n \n class RestoreRequest(StrictModel):\n     name: str = Field(min_length=10, max_length=73)\n     promote: bool = False\n",

              "deletions": 1,
              "status": "modified"

Parse offsets before comparison because Yahoo's intraday and target strings can use UTC/local.\n     assert all(\n         datetime.fromisoformat(result[\"origin_timestamp\"])\n         < datetime.fromisoformat(result[\"target_timestamp\"])\n         for result in results\n     )\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.live\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n+    (\"query\", \"symbol\", \"asset_type\"),\n+    [\n+        (\"ProFrac Holding\", \"ACDC\", \"stock\"),\n+        (\"SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust\", \"SPY\", \"etf\"),\n+    ],\n+)\n+def test_live_yahoo_company_lookup_returns_complete_identity(query, symbol, asset_type):\n+    identities = YahooProvider(timeout=15).lookup(query, 5, datetime.now(UTC))\n+    identity = next(item for item in identities if item.canonical_symbol == symbol)\n+\n+    assert identity.company_name\n+    assert identity.display_name\n+    assert identity.asset_type == asset_type\n+    assert identity.exchange and identity.currency and identity.timezone and identity.quote_type\n",

-1,80 +1,81 @@\n // Exercise the configured MCP transport and a real headless Chromium context with bounded I/O.\n const { spawn } = require(\"node:child_process\");\n const fs = require(\"node:fs\");\n const path = require(\"node:path\");\n \n const root = path.resolve(__dirname, \"../..\");\n+const task = process.env.STOCK_PROBS_TASK_ID || \"M06\";\n const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, \"opencode.json\"), \"utf8\"));\n const [command, ...args] = config.mcp.playwright.command;\n const child = spawn(command, args, { cwd: root, stdio: [\"pipe\", \"pipe\", \"pipe\"] });\n let stdout = \"\";\n let stderr = \"\";\n let finished = false;\n \n function send(message) {\n   child.stdin.write(`${JSON.stringify(message)}\\n`);\n }\n \n function fail(message) {\n   if (finished) return;\n   finished = true;\n   child.kill(\"SIGTERM\");\n   console.error(`${message}${stderr ? `\\n${stderr}` : \"\"}`);\n   process.exitCode = 1;\n }\n \n const timer = setTimeout(() => fail(\"MCP smoke timed out after 20 seconds.\"), 20_000);\n child.stderr.on(\"data\", (chunk) => {\n   stderr += chunk.toString();\n   if (stderr.length > 65_536) fail(\"MCP stderr exceeded its smoke-test limit.\");\n });\n child.stdout.on(\"data\", (chunk) => {\n   stdout += chunk.toString();\n   if (stdout.length > 1_048_576) return fail(\"MCP stdout exceeded its smoke-test limit.\");\n   let newline;\n   while ((newline = stdout.indexOf(\"\\n\")) >= 0) {\n     const line = stdout.slice(0, newline).trim();\n     stdout = stdout.slice(newline + 1);\n     if (!line) continue;\n     let message;\n     try {\n       message = JSON.parse(line);\n     } catch (error) {\n       return fail(`MCP returned invalid JSON: ${error.message}`);\n     }\n     if (message.id === 1) {\n       send({ jsonrpc: \"2.0\", method: \"notifications/initialized\" });\n       send({ jsonrpc: \"2.0\", id: 2, method: \"tools/list\", params: {} });\n     } else if (message.id === 2) {\n       const names = (message.result?.tools || []).map((tool) => tool.name);\n       if (!names.includes(\"browser_tabs\")) return fail(\"Official browser tools were not listed.\");\n       send({\n         jsonrpc: \"2.0\",\n         id: 3,\n         method: \"tools/call\",\n         params: { name: \"browser_tabs\", arguments: { action: \"list\" } },\n       });\n     } else if (message.id === 3) {\n       if (message.error || message.result?.isError) return fail(\"Chromium context initialization failed.\");\n       finished = true;\n       clearTimeout(timer);\n       child.kill(\"SIGTERM\");\n-      console.log(\"M06 MCP smoke passed: official tools and isolated Chromium responded.\");\n+      console.log(`${task} MCP smoke passed: official tools and isolated Chromium responded.`);\n     }\n   }\n });\n child.on(\"error\", (error) => fail(`MCP process could not start: ${error.message}`));\n child.on(\"exit\", (code) => {\n   if (!finished) fail(`MCP process exited before completing the smoke test (${code}).`);\n });\n \n send({\n   jsonrpc: \"2.0\",\n   id: 1,\n   method: \"initialize\",\n   params: {\n     protocolVersion: \"2025-06-18\",\n     capabilities: {},\n-    clientInfo: { name: \"stock-probs-m06-smoke\", version: \"1.0.0\" },\n+    clientInfo: { name: `stock-probs-${task.toLowerCase()}-smoke`, version: \"1.0.0\" },\n   },\n });\n",

              "status": "modified"

require(\"@playwright/test\");\n+const { spawn } = require(\"node:child_process\");\n+const net = require(\"node:net\");\n+const path = require(\"node:path\");\n+const fs = require(\"node:fs/promises\");\n \n+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, \"../../..\");\n+\n+async function freeLoopbackPort() {\n+  const server = net.createServer();\n+  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n+    server.once(\"error\", reject);\n+    server.listen(0, \"127.0.0.1\", resolve);\n+  });\n+  const port = server.address().port;\n+  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => server.close((error) => (error ? reject(error) : resolve())));\n+  return port;\n+}\n+\n+async function waitForReadiness(url, processState, label) {\n+  const deadline = Date.now() + 10_000;\n+  while (Date.now() < deadline) {\n+    if (processState.exit !== null) {\n+      throw new Error(`${label} exited early (${processState.exit}): ${processState.stderr}`);\n+    }\n+    try {\n+      const response = await fetch(`${url}/api/v1/readiness`);\n+      if (response.ok) return;\n+    } catch (_) {\n+      // A refused connection is expected while the local process binds its loopback port.\n+    }\n+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));\n+  }\n+  throw new Error(`${label} did not become ready: ${processState.stderr}`);\n+}\n+\n+async function launchApplication(testInfo, runtimeName, pythonArguments, label) {\n+  const port = await freeLoopbackPort();\n+  const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;\n+  const runtime = testInfo.outputPath(runtimeName);\n+  // Runtime removal belongs outside start() because restart regressions intentionally retain it.\n+  await fs.rm(runtime, { recursive: true, force: true });\n+  await fs.mkdir(runtime, { recursive: true });\n+  let child = null;\n+  let processState = null;\n+\n+  async function start() {\n+    if (child) throw new Error(`${label} is already running.`);\n+    processState = { exit: null, stderr: \"\" };\n+    child = spawn(path.join(root, \".dev-venv/bin/python\"), pythonArguments(port), {\n+      cwd: root,\n+      env: {\n+        ...process.env,\n+        STOCK_PROBS_DATA_DIR: runtime,\n+        STOCK_PROBS_PROVIDER: \"fixture\",\n+        STOCK_PROBS_FIXTURE_NOW: \"2025-01-10T17:03:00+00:00\",\n+        STOCK_PROBS_PORT: String(port),\n+      },\n+      stdio: [\"ignore\", \"ignore\", \"pipe\"],\n+    });\n+    const runningChild = child;\n+    runningChild.stderr.on(\"data\", (chunk) => {\n+      processState.stderr = `${processState.stderr}${chunk}`.slice(-16_384);\n+    });\n+    runningChild.once(\"exit\", (code) => {\n+      processState.exit = code;\n+      if (child === runningChild) child = null;\n+    });\n+    await waitForReadiness(url, processState, label);\n+  }\n+\n+  async function stop() {\n+    if (!child) return;\n+    const stoppingChild = child;\n+    const exited = new Promise((resolve) => stoppingChild.once(\"exit\", resolve));\n+    stoppingChild.kill(\"SIGTERM\");\n+    await Promise.race([exited, new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 5_000))]);\n+    if (stoppingChild.exitCode === null) {\n+      stoppingChild.kill(\"SIGKILL\");\n+      await exited;\n+    }\n+    if (child === stoppingChild) child = null;\n+  }\n+\n+  await start();\n+  return { url, restart: async () => { await stop(); await start(); }, stop };\n+}\n+\n exports.expect = base.expect;\n exports.test = base.test.extend({\n   applicationRequests: async ({ page }, use) => {\n     const requests = [];\n     page.on(\"request\", (request) => {\n       if ([\"fetch\", \"xhr\"].includes(request.resourceType())) requests.push(request.url());\n     });\n     await use(requests);\n   },\n+  restartableApplication: async ({}, use, testInfo) => {\n+    const application = await launchApplication(\n+      testInfo,\n+      \"restart-runtime\",\n+      (port) => [\"-m\", \"stock_probs.cli\", \"serve\", \"--host\", \"127.0.0.1\", \"--port\", String(port)],\n+      \"Restart test application\",\n+    );\n+    try {\n+      await use({ url: application.url, restart: application.restart });\n+    } finally {\n+      await application.stop();\n+    }\n+  },\n+  unexpectedFailureApplication: async ({}, use, testInfo) => {\n+    const application = await launchApplication(\n+      testInfo,\n+      \"unexpected-failure-runtime\",\n+      () => [path.join(root, \"tools/browser/unexpected_failure_app.py\")],\n+      \"Unexpected-failure test application\",\n+    );\n+    try {\n+      await use({ url: application.url });\n+    } finally {\n+      await application.stop();\n+    }\n+  },\n });\n",

              "patch": "Index: tools/browser/unexpected_failure_app.py\n===================================================================\n--- tools/browser/unexpected_failure_app.py\t\n+++ tools/browser/unexpected_failure_app.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@\n+\"\"\"Launch a browser-only app that deterministically exercises the generic error boundary.\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import uvicorn\n+\n+from stock_probs.api import create_app\n+from stock_probs.config import Settings\n+\n+\n+def main() -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Replace one operation adapter with a hostile unexpected failure and serve on loopback.\"\"\"\n+\n+    settings = Settings.from_env()\n+    application = create_app(settings=settings)\n+\n+    def injected_failure(_: str) -> None:\n+        # The browser must receive none of these engine, table, statement, or machine details.\n+        raise RuntimeError(\n+            \"SQLite database /srv/private/main.sqlite3 failed: \"\n+            \"SELECT * FROM forecast_runs\"\n+        )\n+\n+    application.state.backups.create = injected_failure\n+    uvicorn.run(\n+        application,\n+        host=\"127.0.0.1\",\n+        port=settings.port,\n+        workers=1,\n+        limit_concurrency=8,\n+        backlog=8,\n+        timeout_keep_alive=2,\n+        timeout_graceful_shutdown=5,\n+    )\n+\n+\n+if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n+    main()\n",

              "name": "devops-conventions"
            },
            "output": "<skill_content name=\"devops-conventions\">\n# Skill: devops-conventions\n\n# DevOps Conventions\n\n> Unified conventions across three domains: CLI toolkit, Docker authoring & management, and Kubernetes manifests.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Constructing shell pipelines or parsing JSON/text output\n- Writing or editing Dockerfiles, Containerfiles, compose files, `.dockerignore`\n- Managing Docker system resources (build cache, volumes, logs)\n- Writing Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, or Kustomize overlays\n\n## 🔴 HARD RULEs\n\n### 🔴 NEVER Pipe Curl to Shell\n\nNever pipe `curl ... | sh` or `curl ... | bash`. Always download, inspect, then run.\n\n```bash\n# ❌ BAD — blind execution\ncurl -sSL https://example.com/install.sh | bash\n\n# ✅ GOOD — inspect first\ncurl -sSL https://example.com/install.sh > install.sh\nless install.sh && bash install.sh\n```\n\n### 🔴 NEVER Touch `$HOME/repos` or `/mnt`\n\nThe `$HOME/repos` directory and all subdirectories are off-limits for any Docker cleanup, WSL maintenance, or file operations. The `/mnt` directory (Windows drive mounts) is also off-limits. Before running ANY command that operates on paths, verify the path does not start with `$HOME/repos`, `/mnt`, or a resolved equivalent.\n\n### 🔴 Assess Before Acting; Confirm Before Destruction\n\nShow disk usage (`df -h`) before any destructive operation. Always confirm with the user before `docker system prune`, `apt autoremove --purge`, `rm -rf`, or similar destructive commands.\n\n### 🔴 Shell Safety\n\nMulti-command shell statements must follow `set -euo pipefail` safety patterns. Quote all variable expansions, use `|| true` tolerance for commands that may fail, never background processes with `&`.\n\n### 🔴 NEVER Append Output Redirection to Terminal Commands\n\nNever append `2>&1`, `>/dev/null`, `&>/dev/null`, or any standard output/error redirection to commands. All tool outputs must stream raw text back to the shell environment. Hiding output prevents error detection and debugging.\n\n```bash\n# ❌ WRONG — hiding output breaks error detection\ncurl http://localhost:4097/health 2>&1 | grep ok\ndocker ps 2>/dev/null\nnpm test &>/dev/null\n\n# ✅ CORRECT — full output, handle errors explicitly\ncurl http://localhost:4097/health\ndocker ps\nnpm test\n```\n\n### 🔴 Use `docker compose`, NOT `docker-compose`\n\nThe `docker-compose` standalone binary (with hyphen) is deprecated. Always use the modern Docker Compose plugin:\n\n```bash\n# ❌ WRONG — docker-compose (hyphen) not installed on modern Docker\ndocker-compose config\ndocker-compose up -d\n\n# ✅ CORRECT — docker compose (space) is the modern command\ndocker compose config\ndocker compose up -d\ndocker compose ps\n```\n\nThe hyphen variant is a legacy Python script that may not exist on the system. The space variant is built into the Docker CLI as a plugin. Always use `docker compose` (space).\n\n### 🔴 Use `docker compose` for Container Lifecycle — Not Raw `docker run`\n\nAll container lifecycle management must go through `docker compose` — never raw `docker run`, `docker rm`, or `docker stop` commands. The `docker compose` tool manages networks, volumes, and dependencies correctly.\n\n```bash\n# ❌ WRONG — raw docker commands bypass compose orchestration\ndocker run -d --name myapp ...\ndocker rm -f myapp\ndocker stop myapp\n\n# ✅ CORRECT — compose handles networking, volumes, healthchecks, dependencies\ndocker compose up -d\ndocker compose down\ndocker compose restart\ndocker compose logs\ndocker compose ps\n```\n\n## Reference Files\n\n### CLI Toolkit\n\n| File | Content |\n|------|---------|\n| [`references/cli-toolkit/toolkit.md`](references/cli-toolkit/toolkit.md) | jq, curl, sed, awk, find + xargs, grep — flags, recipes, gotchas |\n\n### Docker\n\n| File | Content |\n|------|---------|\n| [`references/docker/authoring.md`](references/docker/authoring.md) | Multi-stage builds, non-root user, layer ordering, .dockerignore, pin digests, HEALTHCHECK, signal handling, secrets, image size |\n| [`references/docker/management.md`](references/docker/management.md) | Pre-flight assessment, build cache optimization, system prune, volume lifecycle, GC, log management, cleanup script |\n\n### Kubernetes\n\n| File | Content |\n|------|---------|\n| [`references/kubernetes/manifests.md`](references/kubernetes/manifests.md) | Security context, resource limits, probes, network policies, labels, deployment strategy, service types, Ingress, ConfigMaps |\n\n### Shell Scripts\n\n| File | Content |\n|------|---------|\n| [`references/shell-scripts/scripting.md`](references/shell-scripts/scripting.md) | Safety flags, quoting, error handling,             "output": "<skill_content name=\"customize-opencode\">\n# Skill: customize-opencode\n\n<!--\n  Built-in skill. Name and description are registered in code at\n  packages/core/src/plugin/skill.ts\n  and CUSTOMIZE_OPENCODE_SKILL_DESCRIPTION). The body below becomes the\n  skill's content.\n-->\n\n# Customizing opencode\n\nopencode validates its own config strictly and refuses to start when a field\nis wrong. The shapes below cover the common surface area, but they are a\n**summary, not the source of truth**.\n\n## Full schema reference\n\nThe authoritative list of every config option — with field types, enums,\ndefaults, and descriptions — lives in the published JSON Schema:\n\n**<https://opencode.ai/config.json>**\n\nIf a field is not documented in this skill, or you need to confirm an exact\nshape before writing config, **fetch that URL and read the schema directly**\nrather than guessing. opencode hard-fails on invalid config, so the cost of a\nwrong shape is a broken startup.\n\nIndependently, every `opencode.json` should declare\n`\"$schema\": \"https://opencode.ai/config.json\"` so the user's editor catches\nmistakes as they type.\n\n## Applying changes\n\nConfig is loaded once when opencode starts and is not hot-reloaded. After\nsaving changes to `opencode.json`, an agent file, a skill, a plugin, or any\nother config-time file, **tell the user to quit and restart opencode** for\nthe changes to take effect. The running session will keep using the\nalready-loaded config until then.\n\n## Where files live\n\n| Scope                         | Path                                                                                                                      |\n| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| Project config                | `./opencode.json`, `./opencode.jsonc`, or `.opencode/opencode.json` (opencode walks up from the cwd to the worktree root) |\n| Global config                 | `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` or `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` (NOT `~/.opencode/`)                            |\n| Project agents                | `.opencode/agent/<name>.md` or `.opencode/agents/<name>.md`                                                               |\n| Global agents                 | `~/.config/opencode/agent(s)/<name>.md`                                                                                   |\n| Project commands              | `.opencode/command/<name>.md` or `.opencode/commands/<name>.md`                                                           |\n| Global commands               | `~/.config/opencode/command(s)/<name>.md`                                                                                 |\n| Project skills                | `.opencode/skill(s)/<name>/SKILL.md`                                                                                      |\n| Global skills                 | `~/.config/opencode/skill(s)/<name>/SKILL.md`                                                                             |\n| External skills (auto-loaded) | `~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, `~/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`                                                    |\n\nConfigs from each scope are deep-merged. Project overrides global. Unknown\ntop-level keys in `opencode.json` are rejected with `ConfigInvalidError`.\n\n## opencode.json\n\nEvery field is optional.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"$schema\": \"https://opencode.ai/config.json\",\n  \"username\": \"string\",\n  \"model\": \"provider/model-id\",\n  \"small_model\": \"provider/model-id\",\n  \"default_agent\": \"agent-name\",\n  \"shell\": \"/bin/zsh\",\n  \"logLevel\": \"DEBUG\" | \"INFO\" | \"WARN\" | \"ERROR\",\n  \"share\": \"manual\" | \"auto\" | \"disabled\",\n  \"autoupdate\": true | false | \"notify\",\n  \"snapshot\": true,\n  \"instructions\": [\"AGENTS.md\", \"docs/style.md\"],\n\n  \"skills\": {\n    \"paths\": [\".opencode/skills\", \"/abs/path/to/skills\"],\n    \"urls\": [\"https://example.com/.well-known/skills/\"]\n  },\n\n  \"references\": {\n    \"docs\": {\n      \"path\": \"../docs\",\n      \"description\": \"Use for product behavior and documentation conventions\"\n    },\n    \"sdk\": {\n      \"repository\": \"owner/sdk\",\n      \"branch\": \"main\",\n      \"description\": \"Use for SDK implementation details\",\n      \"hidden\": true\n    }\n  },\n\n  \"agent\": {\n    \"my-agent\": {\n      \"model\": \"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6\",\n      \"mode\": \"subagent\",\n      \"description\": \"...\",\n      \"permission\": { \"edit\": \"deny\" }\n    }\n  },\n\n  \"command\": {\n    \"deploy\": { \"description\": \"...\", \"template\": \"...\" }\n  },\n\n  \"provider\": {\n    \"anthropic\": { \"options\": { \"apiKey\": \"...\" } }\n  },\n  \"disabled_providers\": [\"openai\"],\n  \"enabled_providers\": [\"anthropic\"],\n\n  \"mcp\": {\n    \"playwright\": {\n      \"type\": \"local\",\n      \"command\": [\"npx\", \"-y\", \"@playwright/mcp\"],\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"environment\": {}\n    },\n    \"remote-thing\": {\n      \"type\": \"remote\",\n      \"url\": \"https://...\",\n      \"headers\": { \"Authorization\": \"Bearer ...\" }\n    }\n  },\n\n  \"plugin\": [\n    \"opencode-gemini-auth\",\n    \"opencode-foo@1.2.3\",\n    \"./local-plugin.ts\",\n    [\"opencode-bar\", { \"option\": \"value\" }]\n  ],\n\n  \"permission\": {\n    \"edit\": \"deny\",\n    \"bash\": { \"git *\": \"allow\", \"*\": \"ask\" }\n  },\n\n  \"formatter\": false,\n  \"lsp\": false,\n\n  \"experimental\": {\n    \"primary_tools\": [\"edit\"],\n    \"mcp_timeout\": 30000\n  },\n\n  \"tool_output\": { \"max_lines\": 200, \"max_bytes\": 8192 },\n\n  \"compaction\": { \"auto\": true, \"tail_turns\": 15 }\n}\n```\n\nShape notes worth being explicit about:\n\n- `model` always carries a provider prefix: `\"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6\"`.\n- `skills` is an object with `paths` and/or `urls`, not an array.\n- `references` is an object keyed by alias. Each value is a local path, Git repository, or string shorthand.\n- `agent` is an object keyed by agent name, not an array.\n- `command` is an object keyed by command name, not an array.\n- `plugin` is an array of strings or `[name, options]` tuples, not an object.\n- `mcp[name].command` is an array of strings, never a single string. `type` is required.\n- `permission` is either a string action or an object keyed by tool name.\n\n## Skills\n\nopencode's skill loader scans for `**/SKILL.md` inside skill directories. The\nfile is named `SKILL.md` exactly, and lives in its own folder named after the\nskill:\n\n```\n.opencode/skills/my-skill/SKILL.md\n```\n\nFrontmatter:\n\n```markdown\n---\nname: my-skill\ndescription: One sentence covering what this skill does AND when to trigger it. Front-load the literal keywords or filenames the user is likely to say.\n---\n\n# My Skill\n\n(skill body in markdown: instructions, examples, references)\n```\n\n- `name` is required, lowercase hyphen-separated, up to 64 chars, and matches the folder name.\n- `description` is effectively required: skills without one are filtered out and never surfaced to the model. Cover both _what_ the skill does and _when_ to use it. Write in third person (\"Use when...\", not \"I help with...\"). Front-load concrete trigger keywords and filenames; gate with \"Use ONLY when...\" if the skill should stay quiet on adjacent topics.\n- Optional: `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata` (string-string map).\n\nRegister skills from non-default locations via `skills.paths` (scanned\nrecursively for `**/SKILL.md`) and `skills.urls` (each URL serves a list of\nskills).\n\n## References\n\nReferences make local directories and Git repositories outside the active\nproject available as supporting context. Configure them under `references`,\nkeyed by the alias used in `@` autocomplete:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"references\": {\n    \"docs\": {\n      \"path\": \"../product-docs\",\n      \"description\": \"Use for product behavior and terminology\"\n    },\n    \"effect\": {\n      \"repository\": \"Effect-TS/effect\",\n      \"branch\": \"main\",\n      \"description\": \"Use for Effect implementation details\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\nLocal `path` values may be relative to the declaring config, absolute, or use\n`~/`. Git `repository` values accept Git URLs, host/path references, and GitHub\n`owner/repo` shorthand; `branch` is optional. Both forms support optional\n`description` and `hidden` fields.\n\n- Only references with a `description` are advertised to agents in system context.\n- `hidden: true` removes a reference from TUI `@` autocomplete only. It remains available to agents and by direct path.\n- Reference directories are automatically allowed through the external-directory boundary; normal read/edit/tool permissions still apply.\n- String shorthand is supported: use `\"docs\": \"../docs\"` for local paths or `\"effect\": \"Effect-TS/effect\"` for Git repositories.\n\n## Agents\n\nTwo ways to define an agent. Use the file form for anything non-trivial.\n\n### Inline (in `opencode.json`)\n\n```json\n{\n  \"agent\": {\n    \"my-reviewer\": {\n      \"description\": \"Reviews PRs for style violations.\",\n      \"mode\": \"subagent\",\n      \"model\": \"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6\",\n      \"permission\": { \"edit\": \"deny\", \"bash\": \"ask\" },\n      \"prompt\": \"You are a strict PR reviewer...\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### File\n\n```\n.opencode/agent/my-reviewer.md      OR     .opencode/agents/my-reviewer.md\n```\n\n```markdown\n---\ndescription: Reviews PRs for style violations.\nmode: subagent\nmodel: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6\npermission:\n  edit: deny\n  bash: ask\n---\n\nYou are a strict PR reviewer. Focus on...\n```\n\nThe file body becomes the agent's `prompt`. Do not also put `prompt:` in the\nfrontmatter.\n\n`mode` is one of `\"primary\"`, `\"subagent\"`, `\"all\"`.\n\nAllowed top-level frontmatter fields: `name, model, variant, description, mode,\nhidden, color, steps, options, permission, disable, temperature, top_p`. Any\nunknown field is silently routed into `options`.\n\nTo disable a built-in agent: `agent: { build: { disable: true } }`, or in a\nfile, `disable: true` in frontmatter.\n\n`default_agent` must point to a non-hidden, primary-mode agent.\n\n### Built-in agents\n\nopencode ships with `build`, `plan`, `general`, `explore`. Hidden internal agents:\n`compaction`, `title`, `summary`. To override a built-in's fields, define the\nsame key in `agent: { <name>: { ... } }`.\n\n## Commands\n\nopencode's command loader scans for `**/*.md` inside command directories. The\nfile is named after the command, and lives directly inside the `command` folder:\n\n```\n.opencode/command/deploy.md\n```\n\nFrontmatter:\n\n```markdown\n---\ndescription: One sentence describing what the command does.\nagent: build\nmodel: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6\n---\n\n(command body in markdown: the prompt opencode runs, with $ARGUMENTS for the user's input)\n```\n\n- `template` is the command body — everything below the frontmatter — and is required: it is the prompt opencode runs when the command is invoked. Do not also put a `template:` key in the frontmatter.\n- `$ARGUMENTS` is replaced with everything the user typed after the command; `$1`, `$2`, … pull individual positional arguments.\n- Optional: `description`, `agent`, `model`, `variant`, `subtask`.\n\n## Plugins\n\n`plugin:` is an array. Each entry is one of:\n\n```json\n\"plugin\": [\n  \"opencode-gemini-auth\",            // npm spec, latest\n  \"opencode-foo@1.2.3\",              // npm spec, pinned\n  \"./local-plugin.ts\",               // file path, relative to the declaring config\n  \"file:///abs/path/plugin.js\",      // file URL\n  [\"opencode-bar\", { \"key\": \"val\" }] // tuple form with options\n]\n```\n\nAuto-discovered plugins (no config entry needed): any `*.ts` or `*.js` file in\n`.opencode/plugin/` or `.opencode/plugins/`.\n\nA plugin module exports `default` (or any named export) of type\n`Plugin = (input: PluginInput, options?) => Promise<Hooks>`. The export is a\nfunction, not a plain object literal, and the function returns an object\n(return `{}` if there is nothing to register).\n\n```ts\nimport type { Plugin } from \"@opencode-ai/plugin\"\n\nexport default (async ({ client, project, directory, $ }) => {\n  return {\n    config: (cfg) => {\n      // cfg is the live merged config; mutate fields here.\n    },\n    \"tool.execute.before\": async (input, output) => {\n      // mutate output.args before the tool runs\n    },\n  }\n}) satisfies Plugin\n```\n\nHook surface (mutate `output` in place; return `void`):\n\n- `event(input)`: every bus event\n- `config(cfg)`: once on init with the merged config\n- `chat.message`, `chat.params`, `chat.headers`\n- `tool.execute.before`, `tool.execute.after`\n- `tool.definition`\n- `command.execute.before`\n- `shell.env`\n- `permission.ask`\n- `experimental.chat.messages.transform`, `experimental.chat.system.transform`,\n  `experimental.session.compacting`, `experimental.compaction.autocontinue`,\n  `experimental.text.complete`\n\nSpecial object-shaped (not callbacks): `tool: { my_tool: { ... } }`,\n`auth: { ... }`, `provider: { ... }`.\n\n## MCP servers\n\n`mcp:` is an object keyed by server name. Each server is discriminated by\n`type`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"mcp\": {\n    \"playwright\": {\n      \"type\": \"local\",\n      \"command\": [\"npx\", \"-y\", \"@playwright/mcp\"],\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"environment\": { \"BROWSER\": \"chromium\" }\n    },\n    \"github\": {\n      \"type\": \"remote\",\n      \"url\": \"https://...\",\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"headers\": { \"Authorization\": \"Bearer {env:GITHUB_TOKEN}\" }\n    },\n    \"old-server\": { \"enabled\": false }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n`command` is an array of strings. `environment` sets environment variables for\na local MCP server. `type` is required. Use `enabled: false` to\ndisable a server inherited from a parent config. String values such as header\ntokens support `{env:VAR}` interpolation (and `{file:path}`); the shell-style\n`${VAR}` is not substituted.\n\n## Permissions\n\n```json\n\"permission\": {\n  \"edit\": \"deny\",\n  \"bash\": { \"git *\": \"allow\", \"rm *\": \"deny\", \"*\": \"ask\" },\n  \"external_directory\": { \"~/secrets/**\": \"deny\", \"*\": \"allow\" }\n}\n```\n\nActions: `\"allow\"`, `\"ask\"`, `\"deny\"`.\n\nPer-tool value forms: `\"allow\"` shorthand (treated as `{\"*\": \"allow\"}`), or an\nobject `{ pattern: action }`. Within an object, **insertion order matters**.\nopencode evaluates the LAST matching rule, so put broad rules first and narrow\nrules last.\n\n`permission: \"allow\"` (a string at the top level) is shorthand for \"allow\neverything\" and is rarely what the user wants.\n\nKnown permission keys: `read, edit, glob, grep, list, bash, task,\nexternal_directory, todowrite, question, webfetch, websearch, lsp, doom_loop,\nskill`. Some of these (`todowrite,\nquestion, webfetch, websearch, doom_loop`) only accept a flat\naction, not a per-pattern object.\n\n`external_directory` patterns are filesystem paths (use `~/`, absolute paths,\nor globs like `~/projects/**`).\n\nPer-agent `permission:` overrides top-level `permission:`. Plan Mode lives on\nthe `plan` agent's permission ruleset (`edit: deny *`).\n\n## Escape hatches\n\nWhen a user's config is broken and opencode won't start, these env vars help:\n\n- `OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1`: skip the project's local `opencode.json`\n  and start from globals only. Run from the project directory, opencode loads,\n  the user edits the broken file, then they restart without the flag.\n- `OPENCODE_CONFIG=/path/to/file.json`: load an additional explicit config.\n- `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT='{\"$schema\":\"https://opencode.ai/config.json\"}'`:\n  inject inline JSON as a final local-scope merge.\n- `OPENCODE_DISABLE_DEFAULT_PLUGINS=1`: skip default plugins.\n- `OPENCODE_PURE=1`: skip external plugins entirely.\n- `OPENCODE_DISABLE_EXTERNAL_SKILLS=1`,\n  `OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILLS=1`: skip the external skill scans under\n  `~/.claude/` and `~/.agents/`.\n\n## When proposing edits\n\n- Validate against the schema before writing. If you are unsure of a field's\n  exact shape, or the field is not covered in this skill, fetch\n  `https://opencode.ai/config.json` and read the schema rather than guessing.\n- Preserve `$schema` and any existing fields the user did not ask to change.\n- For agent, command, skill, and plugin definitions, prefer creating new files\n  in the correct location over inlining everything in `opencode.json`.\n- If the user's existing config is malformed, point them at the env-var escape\n  hatches above so they can edit from inside opencode without breaking their\n  session.\n- After saving any config change, remind the user to quit and restart opencode\n  — running sessions keep using the already-loaded config.\n\nBase directory for this skill: .\nRelative paths in this skill (e.g., scripts/, reference/) are relative to this base directory.\nNote: file list is sampled.\n\n<skill_files>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/README.md</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/MVP-ROADMAP.md</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/prob_calc.py</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/pyproject.toml</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/SESSION-EXPORT.md</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/tools/browser/mcp-smoke.js</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/.vscode/settings.json</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/requirements.lock</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/prob_calc_hardcoded.py</file>\n<file>/home/brajam/repos/stock_probs/tools/browser/tests/fixtures.js</file>\n</skill_files>\n</skill_content>",
